paper_id: string — file name without extension, e.g. ref21_NK-CDC

materials.composition_label: string — as written in paper, e.g. SDC-Na2CO3 (80:20 wt%)
materials.ceria_dopant: string or null — Sm, Gd, Ca+Sm, Al, Ba ...
materials.dopant_fraction: number or null — mole fraction of dopant on Ce site
materials.secondary_phase: string or null — Na2CO3, Li/Na carbonate, LiNaK carbonate, none
materials.synthesis_route: string or null — co-precipitation, sol-gel, glycine-nitrate, solid-state mixing, core-shell coating ...
materials.measurement_method: string or null — EIS, 2-probe DC, 4-probe DC, other
materials.atmosphere: string or null — air, N2, H2, wet H2, fuel-cell condition
materials.conductivity_type: string or null — total, grain, grain-boundary, ionic, unspecified
materials.conductivity_S_cm: number or null — value at reference temperature
materials.fuel: string or null — H2, CH4, biogas ...
materials.durability_h: number or null — longest stability test reported
materials.notes: string or null — anything ambiguous, unit conversions made, caveats

extraction_notes: string — what was unclear or missing in the paper
